Амилметакрезол C12H18O = 178.3. CAS — 1300-94-3. Pharmacopoeias. In Br. BP 2008 (Amylmetacresol). A clear or almost clear liquid or a solid crystalline mass with a characteristic odour, colourless or slightly yellow when freshly prepared; it darkens on keeping. F.p. about 22°. Practically insoluble in water; soluble in alcohol, in ether, and in fixed and volatile oils. Protect from light. Profile Amylmetacresol is a phenolic antiseptic used chiefly as an ingre- dient of lozenges in the treatment of minor infections of the mouth and throat.
